lm_metadata.caption: A smooth, instrumental neo-soul track built on a relaxed lo-fi hip-hop groove. A clean-toned electric guitar enters to play soulful melodic lines that complement the keyboard melody. The arrangement briefly breaks down into an atmospheric section featuring just shimmering keys before rebuilding for a final groovy statement and ending abruptly after a brief vocal sample chop.

lm_metadata.caption: An aggressive hybrid trap track that opens with an atmospheric synth melody before slamming into a high-energy buildup driven by accelerating snare rolls and risers. The main drop features a powerful, distorted kick drum pattern characteristic of hardstyle or hardcore, layered over sharp snares and rapid-fire hi-hats. A screeching, pitch-bending synth lead cuts through the mix, accompanied by rhythmic vocal chops used percussively. The arrangement follows a classic EDM structure with intense buildups leading to heavy drops, followed by brief melodic breakdowns providing contrast before launching back into the aggressive rhythm. An outro section introduces arpeggiated synths reminiscent of chiptune or video game music, which then fades out abruptly after a final impactful hit.
